battle.name: 唐與吐蕃戰爭
battle.brief: 武德六年（623）夏，吐蕃贊普松贊干布趁唐廷平定劉武周、劉黑闥之際，率軍越過湟水，攻入鄯、階一帶邊州，掠取人畜，唐高祖遣邊軍討之，唐蕃戰爭自河湟谷地拉開序幕。唐軍據城待敵，秦弩與各式弩兵在城頭覆射、封鎖谷道，把吐蕃騎兵擋在牆外，成為唐蕃角力中最早的守城利器。

kit.name: 秦弩
kit.history: 弩機把拉力存起來，射速遠勝拉弓。守城的一方靠它把攻城的人壓在牆外。

countries: 這場戰爭的開端，是唐王朝與吐蕃王朝在青海、河湟一線的直接碰撞。唐一方承隋朝留下的邊防體系：隋文帝開皇年間在河西、青海一帶置鄯州、湟州、積石山軍、洮州等軍州，籍民為兵，開屯田、養馬牧；武德年間唐廷先後平定劉武周、劉黑闥，隴右丁壯大批徵調，邊鎮一度空虛，至貞觀元年劃天下為十道，置隴右道、河西道，軍籍歸兵部，邊鎮由都督、總管分道節制，兵種兼有府兵、募兵與蕃兵，步卒執槊、配橫刀，弓弩隨身，騎兵著明光具、披鍔甲。吐蕃一方則是松贊干布在青藏高原整合諸部建立的政權，都城邏些，國政由贊普與大論共治，軍隊以部落為編組單位，輕騎為主幹，弓箭手與重裝步兵為輔，並自中亞、印度一帶吸收鐵甲與攻城技術。兩軍隔著吐谷渾與高山相望，爭的是青海的鹽、馬匹、糧食，以及橫穿高原通往西域的商道。
countriesEn: The opening phase of this war was a direct collision between the Tang dynasty and the Tibetan empire along the Qinghai and Huangshui frontier. On the Tang side the military inherited the frontier system built by the Sui: under Emperor Wen of Sui the Sui had established military prefectures such as Shanzhou, Huangzhou, Jishishan Army and Taozhou across Hexi and Qinghai, registering households for service, opening garrison fields and running horse pastures. During the Wude era the Tang court was busy suppressing Liu Wuzhou and Liu Hedou, and the crews and grain of Longyou were stripped away for the campaigns in Guanzhong and Guandong, leaving the border towns thinly held; only in the first year of Zhenguan, when the empire was divided into ten circuits, were Longyou and Hexi made formal circuits, with the Ministry of War keeping the rolls and the border towns commanded by metropolitan governors and commissioners. Manpower was mixed: imperial-service militia, recruited soldiers and foreign auxiliaries. Foot soldiers carried long spears and horizontal sabres, with bows and crossbows at hand, while cavalry wore gleaming breastplates and lamellar armour. The Tibetan side was the state Songtsen Gampo had assembled on the Tibetan plateau, capital at Lhasa, where the sovereign and the senior minister (dpon) shared authority, and where the army was organised tribe by tribe, light horse being the backbone, supported by archers and heavily armed infantry, and drawing iron armour and siegecraft from Central Asia and India. The two armies faced each other across the Tuyuhun and the high passes, contending for the salt, horses and grain of Qinghai and for the trade road that crossed the plateau towards the Western Regions.
people: 吐蕃方面的核心人物是贊普松贊干布。他大約在貞觀初年統一高原諸部，年紀甚輕而雄心極盛，執政之後先向東掃平吐谷渾，再把兵鋒指向唐的邊州；每次出兵的後方與交涉，多由大論祿東贊·頓珠爾主持，此人以漢文名字見於兩唐史書，後世多作祿東贊，是第一位持國書抵達長安的吐蕃重臣。漢地方面，武德朝政事由中書令房玄齡與兵部尚書侯君集一系參預，侯君集曾上兵法論，縱論河西山川道里與敵我形勢，是唐廷最早系統談吐蕃與吐谷渾兵事的臣僚；將門之中，李靖熟悉西域山川，貞觀九年即以輕兵奇襲滅吐谷渾，為後來經營青海樹立模範。唐蕃初年的敗績多由非戰之故：吐谷渾可汗慕容伏允與其子慕容步鍶內鬨，吐蕃乘虛而入，唐廷倉卒應戰，將領姓名與戰果在史籍中記載不一，後人只能從《舊唐書》《新唐書》《資治通鑑》的零星文字拼出這段戰事的大概。
peopleEn: The central figure on the Tibetan side was the sovereign Songtsen Gampo, who unified the plateau tribes early in the Zhenguan era, was very young when he took power and was determined to expand. He first swept eastward through the Tuyuhun and then turned his armies against the Tang border prefectures; the planning behind each campaign and the diplomacy that followed were in the hands of the dpon Gar Tongtsen Yülsung, known in the two Tang histories by the Chinese transcription Lu Dongzan, the first Tibetan weight-bearer to reach the Tang capital with a state letter. On the Chinese side, during the Wude years, government business in the capital was shared by Fang Xuanling, chancellor of the Central Secretariat, and the war minister Hou Junji, the latter of whom presented a treatise on warfare surveying the mountains, rivers and roads of Hexi and the relative strength of the enemy, making him the earliest Tang official to argue systematically about Tibetan and Tuyuhun campaigning. Among the generals Li Jing was the one who knew the mountains and rivers of the Western Regions, and in the ninth year of Zhenguan he destroyed the Tuyuhun state by a light fast stroke, a model for later operations in Qinghai. The early Tang defeats were largely the result of misfortune rather than bad soldiers: the Tuyuhun khan Murong Fuyun and his son Murong Busu fought for the throne, the Tibetans marched in during that quarrel and the Tang answered hastily. The names of the commanders and the scale of the fighting are recorded inconsistently, so the opening years of this war can only be reconstructed in outline from scattered lines in the Old and New Tang histories and the Comprehensive Mirror.
kits: 卡面這件秦弩，在唐蕃戰役中不是主角，卻是最早被投入的守城利器。所謂秦弩，即漢末馬鈞改良、唐代仍沿用的蹶張弩，弩臂安裝銅製弩機，機括儲力，張弦之後可連續發矢，人稱諸葛弩；它射程不及唐軍強弓的拋射距離，但射速遠勝拉弓、破甲力強，一次上弦可出數箭，適合在城頭或陣前對密集隊形反覆覆射。唐制步卒以槊、刀、弓、弩為隨身兵仗，什伍之中必有弩手，邊鎮城郭則設弩棚、排弩與臨城射臺，用以封鎖谷道、遮斷接近的騎兵。除弩之外，唐軍尚有橫刀、長槊、明光具、鍔甲、良馬，攻城則用拋車、雲梯、巢車一類攻具，並靠橦車結陣、騎兵兩翼包抄的戰法破敵。吐蕃方面的裝備以亞洲複合弓、長矛、投石索為主，早期多穿皮甲、以獸皮遮蔽要害，鐵鎧則屬後期自西域換取之物，後勤靠犛牛、騾馬馱運，高原行程與戰馬體力是吐蕃遠征的根本限制。
kitsEn: The crossbow on the card was never the star of the Tang-Tibetan campaigns, but it was the earliest weapon of the war to be committed. The so-called Qin crossbow is the cocked crossbow improved in the late Han and still used in the Tang, with a wooden bow arm and a bronze lock that stores the draw: once cocked it can loose several bolts in succession, and later writers call it the Zhuge crossbow. Its range is shorter than that of a Tang composite bow, but its rate of fire is far higher and it pierces armour; a single cocking lets the shooter put bolt after bolt into a dense formation, which makes it a weapon for the wall or the front line, not for open field. Tang foot soldiers carried spear, sabre, bow and crossbow as standard kit, crossbowmen stood in every sub-unit, and frontier towns built crossbow sheds, ranks of bows and shooting platforms on the walls to seal the valley roads and hold approaching horsemen at bay. Besides the crossbow, the Tang fielded horizontal sabres, long spears, gleaming breastplates, lamellar armour and fast horses; for attack they used traction artillery, scaling ladders and siege towers, and they broke the enemy with a barricade of spiked wagons, infantry in the centre and cavalry on both wings. The Tibetans relied on Asian composite bows, long spears and sling-stones; in the early period they wore mostly hide coats, iron plate came later and was bought from the West, and their logistics rested on yaks, mules and horses, so the endurance of their mounts and the length of their supply line on the plateau were the hard limits on every expedition.
tactics: 雙方的戰術起點完全相反。吐蕃騎兵求快求亂：多以數千騎為一隊，選擇山谷與隘口突然出現，前列以投射武器覆射、兩翼迂迴包抄，待唐軍陣形露出缺口便湧上衝撞，遇到唐軍結陣不動則立刻退開，重新糾集再攻，靠的是高原耐力與機動，而非攻城器械。唐軍則以守字當先：據城以弩，弩手在城頭分番覆射，把敵騎壓在牆外坡下，再以騎兵由側翼出城反擊，掩護步卒出城列陣，糧草則由河西沿湟水河谷北運，車隊由橦車環衛。進攻時，唐軍沿河谷一線穩紮穩打，先取小城、斷水斷糧，逼吐蕃主力離開高原本陣；這套由弩陣、拒馬、車陣與騎兵反擊組成的打法，後來在平定吐谷渾與對西域諸國的戰役中一再使用，成效遠勝正面硬撼。
tacticsEn: The two sides began from opposite tactical assumptions. Tibetan horsemen sought speed and disorder: bands of several thousand riders would suddenly appear in a valley or at a pass, put down showers of missiles from the front, send wings round to envelop, and as soon as a Tang formation showed a gap they surged into it, striking and riding down. Against a Tang army that stood firm they would break off at once, regroup and come again, relying on the endurance of plateau horses and on mobility rather than on siegecraft. The Tang, by contrast, led with defence: crossbows covered the walls in relays, pinning the enemy horse below the wall and on the slopes, after which cavalry left the gates by the flanks and struck back while infantry came out to form up; grain moved north along the Huangshui valley from Hexi, with wagon trains ringed by spiked carts. When attacking, the Tang advanced step by step up the valley, taking the small forts first, cutting water and supply and drawing the Tibetan main body off its plateau base. This combination of crossbow screen, wagon barricade and cavalry counterstroke was used again and again against the Tuyuhun and against the states of the Western Regions, and it worked far better than meeting the enemy head on in the open.
data: 可考的數字並不密集，只能說明大略的尺度。戰爭自武德六年（623）開端，到會昌年間吐蕃崩潰，前後延續二百餘年，跨越唐高祖、太宗、高宗、武則天、玄宗、肅宗、代宗、德宗、順宗、憲宗、穆宗、敬宗、文宗、武宗、宣宗十餘朝。松贊干布在位約三十三年（618至650），自二十歲上下即位起，最重要的對唐用兵集中在貞觀前期。兵力方面，據《資治通鑑》所載，貞觀十二年（638）吐蕃以二十餘萬眾進攻松州，兵鋒直抵松潘城北；此數字歷來有出入，諸說並存，可作大略量級的參考。城池方面，鄯州、階州、松州、洮州、秦州一線是雙方反覆爭奪的關鍵點，鄯州在咸亨元年（670）陷落，安西四鎮於同年被迫罷鎮，垂拱二年（692）由王孝傑收復，此後三失三得，直到長慶年間（821至823）立約才長期安定。物資方面，文成公主貞觀十五年（641）入藏，隨行攜去佛像、經典、穀物種子、工匠與大批牲畜，這批物資在高原上的實際數量沒有留下可靠記錄。弩的射程各書說法不一，一般以百步上下視為有效射程，實際射距還要看弩的形制與瞄準器具而定。
dataEn: Survivable numbers are thin, so only the scale of the thing can be stated. The war opened in the sixth year of Wude, 623, and ran for more than two centuries until the collapse of the Tibetan state in the Huichang era, crossing the reigns of Gaozu, Taizong, Gaozong, Wu Zetian, Xuanzong, Suzong, Daizong, Dezong, Shunzong, Xianzong, Muzong, Jingzong, Wenzong, Wuzong and Xuanzong of the Tang, more than a dozen reigns in all. Songtsen Gampo ruled for about thirty-three years, 618 to 650, and the heaviest fighting against the Tang fell in the first decades of the Zhenguan era. On troop numbers, the Comprehensive Mirror records that in the twelfth year of Zhenguan, 638, the Tibetans advanced on Songzhou with more than two hundred thousand men and drove the spearhead to the north of the city of Songpan; the figure is disputed and the accounts differ, so it serves only as a rough order of magnitude. On the map, Shanzhou, Jiezhou, Songzhou, Taozhou and Qinzhou formed the line over which both sides fought again and again. Shanzhou fell in the first year of Xianheng, 670, and in the same year the Tang abandoned the four garrisons of Anxi; Wang Xiaojie recovered them in the second year of Chuigong, 692, and they were lost and regained three times over before a long settlement in the Changqing years, 821 to 823. On materiel, when Princess Wencheng entered Tibet in the fifteenth year of Zhenguan, 641, she took with her Buddhist images, scriptures, seed grain, craftsmen and large numbers of animals, but no reliable record survives of the actual quantities that reached the plateau. On the crossbow, sources disagree about range; a hundred paces is usually treated as effective, though the real distance depends on the type of bow and on the sighting devices fitted to it.
cause: 打起來的直接理由，是青海與河湟這塊地帶撞上了兩股同時向外擴張的力量。吐蕃完成高原統一之後，松贊干布需要草場、鹽池、馬群與商路來支撐新生的國家，而青海正是通往西域與唐境的要衝；同一時期的唐王朝剛從隋末戰亂中脫身，關中、關東的戰事牽走了隴右的兵員與糧秣，河湟一線的城防與屯田都被抽空，給了吐蕃可乘之機。更深一層，是吐谷渾的內部崩解：可汗慕容伏允與其子慕容步鍶爭奪汗位，吐蕃藉機掃平其境，把勢力直接推到唐的邊牆之下。官方往來從一開始就帶著火藥味：武德六年（623）吐蕃遣使抵長安，《新唐書》記其為唐蕃首次正式接觸，而《資治通鑑》把大論祿東贊的到訪記在貞觀八年（634）十一月，兩書互有出入；使節、表文與邊地牧場的爭執，幾次險些擦出火星。於是，衝突沿著一條越來越長的邊界線慢慢定型，最終變成一場橫跨兩個世紀的消耗。
causeEn: The immediate reason for the fighting was that Qinghai and the Huangshui valley lay where two expanding powers met. Once the Tibetans had unified the plateau, Songtsen Gampo needed pastures, salt pans, horse herds and trade routes to sustain the new state, and Qinghai was the hinge towards the Western Regions and the Tang border. At the same time the Tang had only just emerged from the wars that ended the Sui, and the fighting in Guanzhong and Guandong drew away the soldiers and provisions of Longyou, hollowing out the garrisons and the garrison fields along the Huangshui and leaving a gap the Tibetans could exploit. Deeper down lay the collapse of the Tuyuhun: khan Murong Fuyun and his son Murong Busu fought for the throne, the Tibetans used the quarrel to reduce that state, and their power moved straight up against the Tang frontier wall. Official contact was charged from the start. In the sixth year of Wude, 623, a Tibetan envoy reached the Tang capital, which the New Tang history records as the first formal contact between the two states, while the Comprehensive Mirror dates the arrival of the dpon Lu Dongzan to the eleventh month of the eighth year of Zhenguan, 634; the two accounts do not agree. Rivalries over envoys, written memorials and grazing grounds came close to sparks more than once, and the dispute hardened along a frontier line that grew longer, until it became an attritional war lasting two centuries.
impact: 623年之後的每一次交鋒，都在唐蕃邊境上留下制度與地盤的痕跡。唐廷因為屢遭青海方向的反覆進逼，逐步把防線從河湟推向隴右一線，州城普遍加高加厚，弩棚、砲位、馬廄與屯田水渠一齊開闢，邊軍的騎兵與馬政受到長期扭曲，隴右、幽州一帶的蕃兵與降將大量進入軍籍，軍隊構成變得比唐初複雜得多。絲路方面，安西四鎮三失三得，西域商路時斷時通，吐蕃控制青海與河西的一段時間裡，粟特、波斯商人改走海路或草原小道；唐高宗永徽年間（652至653），裴行儉護送波斯質子阿全歸國，行程一萬餘里而往返兩年，途中穿越吐蕃控制的雪山地帶，就是最生動的例子。更大的震盪發生在安史之亂前後：廣德元年（763）吐蕃一度攻入長安，京師人心惶惶，最後是靠借回鶻兵才收復失地；此後唐廷對吐蕃的政策從以兵制敵轉向以外交固邊，水陸並進的會盟、互市與和婚安排，取代了早期斷續的邊戰。
impactEn: Every clash after 623 left a mark on the institutions and the map of the Tang-Tibetan border. Because the Tang were repeatedly pressed from Qinghai, the defence line moved gradually from the Huangshui up into Longyou; the prefectural towns were raised and thickened, crossbow sheds, artillery positions, stables and irrigation channels for the garrison fields were opened together, and the cavalry and the horse administration of the frontier were distorted for the long term. Foreign soldiers and surrendered leaders from Longyou and Youzhou poured into the registers, and the composition of the armies became far more complicated than it had been in the early Tang. On the silk road, the four garrisons of Anxi were lost and regained, the western trade route opened and closed by turns, and while the Tibetans held stretches of Qinghai and Hexi the Sogdian and Persian merchants diverted to sea lanes or to small steppe tracks. In the Yonghui years, 652 to 653, Pei Xingjian escorted the Persian hostage Ahquan home, a journey of more than ten thousand li that took two years in all, part of it through snowy country under Tibetan control; it is the most vivid illustration of the point. The greater shock came around the An Lushan rebellion: in the first year of Guangde, 763, the Tibetans entered Chang'an itself and the capital panicked, and only the arrival of Uighur troops allowed the lost ground to be recovered. After that the Tang turned from meeting the Tibetans with troops to holding the border by diplomacy, and a succession of alliances, markets and marriage arrangements replaced the sporadic border wars of the early years.
result: 就623年那一季的戰局而言，雙方都沒有取得決定性的勝負。吐蕃一度攻入鄯、階等邊州，掠走人畜與牲畜後退回高原；唐廷在擊退來敵之後沒有乘勢深入，只把兵力收攏回城，加固湟水沿線的關隘與屯田，這種守住河湟、不讓高原勢力坐大的取向，之後延續了數十年，成為唐朝的既定邊策。吐蕃則在牧業與騎兵得到補充後，繼續西進天山、南下安西，把唐朝逼入安西四鎮與河西走廊的拉鋸，最終雙方在長慶年間於長安立約，以石碑記下互不侵犯與互市之約，名義上劃定了唐蕃邊界。真正的結局出現在會昌二年（842）：末代贊普被部將所殺，吐蕃隨即陷入內戰與分裂，其控制的河西、隴右、青海先後脫離，張議潮等起兵收復河西諸州。史籍對唐蕃最初十年的記載零碎而互相矛盾，前因後果多有諸說並存之處，但可以確定的是：這場戰爭的序幕一旦拉開，就再也沒有真正收束，直到吐蕃本身在高原上崩解。
resultEn: Judged by the fighting of that one season in 623, neither side won a decisive success. The Tibetans entered the border prefectures of Shanzhou and Jiezhou, carried off people and animals, and then withdrew to the plateau; the Tang drove the raiders off but did not pursue, simply drawing the troops back into the towns and strengthening the passes and the garrison fields along the Huangshui. That policy of holding the Huangshui and refusing to let the plateau power grow stronger at the Tang's expense lasted for decades and became the settled frontier policy of the dynasty. The Tibetans, their pastures and horses restored, pressed on west towards the Tian Shan and south towards Anxi, driving the Tang into a long attritional struggle over the four garrisons and the Hexi corridor, and the two sides finally concluded a treaty at Chang'an in the Changqing years, 821 to 823, recorded on a stele that set out mutual non-aggression and the border markets, and drew a nominal line between the two states. The real ending came in the second year of Huichang, 842, when the last sovereign was killed by his own commanders and the Tibetan state fell into civil war and partition; Hexi, Longyou and Qinghai broke away one after another, and leaders such as Zhang Yichao rose to retake the prefectures of Hexi. The record of the first ten years of the Tang-Tibetan war is fragmentary and self-contradictory, and its causes and consequences are in many places the subject of competing accounts, but one thing is certain: once the curtain was up, the war was never truly closed again until the Tibetan state itself came apart on the plateau.
